title: Enhancing Portuguese Variety Identification with Cross-Domain Approaches

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification models on their ability to accurately discriminate between Brazilian and European Portuguese texts across multiple domains, aiming to address the linguistic biases caused by the overrepresentation of Brazilian Portuguese in large language model training corpora.

Testing Language Variety Identification (LVI) classifiers on out-of-domain datasets and applying delexicalization (masking named entities and specific parts-of-speech) to measure and mitigate the models' tendency to rely on non-linguistic spurious correlations (such as geographic entities and thematic content) rather than actual linguistic features.
